account:
It is day 0, just after 09:00. I came from home to the town hall and read the secretary's appointment book, then returned it to its chest. Today's business is correspondence in the office, a market walk at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office time at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow's book includes a grain inspection at the mill at 10:00.

I have not yet discovered anything demonstrably unusual. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. I asked about correspondence and unusual news, but have heard no reply yet. The builder has approached us at the town hall carrying a lantern; I do not know why, and carrying it this morning does not by itself establish anything suspicious. Several townsfolk have passed outside, without any conversation I could hear. My feeling that something is happening without me remains only a suspicion. I have no evidence yet of a particular scheme, its participants, or its purpose. I should hear what the secretary and builder have to say and keep my appointments, using the market walk to learn what residents have actually seen or heard.
